checks: Native role-attention producer inserts one durable envelope for a repeated notification ID
Real MongoDB subscriptions and queue persist the exact event ID and payload
Native callback signature is verified independently by a loopback HTTP receiver
Receiver 503 creates a durable retry with the existing delay and attempt count
Reconstructed worker reads the persisted row and delivers the same envelope successfully
Repeating completed publication does not create or send another delivery
Revoking the existing OAuth grant after enqueue prevents callback delivery and makes the row terminal
transportScope: Only the lowest HTTP transport is redirected inside the test to an owned local receiver. Native signing/envelope/response handling, subscription authorization and durable worker execute unchanged. Production HTTPS/public-address restrictions are not weakened; external TLS callback delivery remains on the separate live-provider checklist.
